title: Abstracts 2 (Trio)
program_note:
Abstracts 2, written for the Winsor Ensemble, is an arrangement of two of the movements of the sextet Abstracts 2.  The music was inspired by manhole covers in the streets of Moscow.  In “Telephone/Rays” I thought about the sound of an old-fashioned telephone bell, ringing and reverberating, causing and being part of a variety of overtone series.  “Tetrominos” reminded me of Tetris, with the way different small objects fit together, and the way one may “zone out”—in a Eastern European way—while playing.
Abstracts 2 is about 8’45” total duration, with the individual movements approximately as shown:
1.  3:10 ii.   5:35
David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
27 November, 2018
